visualRisks.description: The path from row 15 to 27 is obstructed by water, which might confuse players.
There are isolated sections of the map that do not connect well with other parts, such as rows 89 to 103, which could lead to dead ends.

navigationRisks.description: The route seems to have a loop from row 64 back to 53 and then again to 42. This could lead to player frustration if they get stuck in an infinite loop.
The route ends abruptly at row 105 without a clear path forward or any exit point, which could frustrate players who are trying to progress.
